about: The interactions round (2026-10-13; web/src/interact.js, gen/interact/): beating the gate tower's drum yourself, and the town answering. group/use as the other sets. Run: node tools/eleven.mjs sounds/interact.json sfx

drum_strike.use: your own stroke on the gate tower drum (S5.prop.tower_drum_6898), heard standing at it in the tower hall; drum_hit stays the far one for dusk and the watches
drum_strike.prompt: One single heavy stroke on a large barrel drum on a wooden stand, struck with a wooden beater, heard close inside a wooden tower hall: a deep boom with the slap of the skin and a long natural decay ringing in the timber room, no other sounds.

flock_burst.use: the birds living in the trees round the gate tower bursting out of their crowns at the drum's boom (ambient.js startle), played at the nearest crowns
flock_burst.prompt: A flock of small birds bursting out of leafy trees all at once: a loud flurry and rush of many wings, branches and leaves shaking and rustling, a few alarmed chirps, then the flock flying off into the distance. Outdoors, close, dry, no music.

picks_why: drum_strike take 0: a clean boom, low band only, smooth 4 s decay; flock_burst take 1: builds in 0.6 s, a rush of wings and chirps for 1.5 s, then flies off (take 0 a slow soft flutter). Read from envelopes and band levels (gen/interact/progress.md)
